title: Kerala Backwaters & Misty Munnar Hill Escape
hotel_name: Fragrant Nature Resort Munnar & Luxury Private Houseboat
description: Immerse yourself in God's Own Country. Experience misty tea gardens in Munnar, wildlife boat safari in Periyar Thekkady, and an overnight private luxury houseboat cruise along Alleppey's backwaters with fresh Keralite fish curry lunch.
highlights: 2 Nights Stay in Misty Tea Garden Resort Munnar
1 Night Luxury Private Backwater Houseboat Stay in Alleppey
Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary Boat Safari & Elephant Interaction
Kathakali Dance & Kalaripayattu Martial Arts Live Show
Ayurvedic Full Body Massage Session Included

included_services.meals: All Meals on Houseboat (Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Tea, Dinner) & Daily Breakfast in Munnar
included_services.transport: Dedicated AC Private Sedan Driver for Full Circuit
included_services.guide: Experienced Malayalam & English Speaking Chauffeur Guide
included_services.activities: Kathakali Tickets, Wildlife Boat Tickets, Spice Plantation Entry Included

excluded_services: Flight or Train Tickets to Cochin (COK)

itinerary.title: Cochin Arrival & Drive to Munnar
itinerary.description: Pickup from Cochin Airport/Railway Station. Scenic drive to Munnar passing Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check-in to Munnar tea valley resort.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Gardens & Mattupetty Dam Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park (home to Nilgiri Tahr), Tea Museum with live tea tasting, Mattupetty Dam boat ride, and Echo Point.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady Spice Sanctuary Drive
itinerary.description: Drive through cardamom hills to Thekkady. Guided spice plantation tour, Periyar lake boat safari to spot wild elephants, and evening Kathakali cultural show.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat Boarding
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey. Board private deluxe houseboat at 12:00 PM. Traditional Karimeen fish curry lunch served onboard as houseboat glides through palm-fringed backwater canals. Overnight stay on houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Cochin Fort Kochi Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: Check out from houseboat after breakfast. Drive to Fort Kochi. Visit Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, Mattancherry Palace, and Jewish Synagogue.

itinerary.title: Cochin Souvenir Shopping & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning Ayurvedic massage session. Buy banana chips and Kerala spices. Transfer to Cochin Airport for departure flight.

cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 7 days prior to check-in. 50% refund 3-6 days prior.
travel_tips: Munnar nights can get chilly (15°C); carry a light jacket or sweater
Book houseboat air conditioning timings (AC operates 9 PM to 6 AM or 24 hrs based on plan)

faqs.question: Does the houseboat sail all night?
faqs.answer: No, per government safety rules backwater houseboats anchor by 5:30 PM and resume at 8:00 AM.
